chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, placed his cloak down during the funeral of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh, may Allah have mercy on him. He was asked about that, so he said: “Indeed, I saw the angels had placed their cloaks down, so I placed my cloak.”

key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةَ: the angels, whose action the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم observed
key_terms.جِنَازَةِ: funeral procession or bier of the deceased
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ مُعَاذٍ: Saʿd ibn Muʿādh, the deceased mentioned in the report

ai.seo_question: Why did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم place his cloak down at the funeral of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates that the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم placed his cloak down at the funeral of Saʿd ibn Muʿādh. When asked why, he explained that he had seen the angels doing the same, showing the special honor present at that funeral.
